title: Physics-informed token transformer methodology for nonlinear balance laws. I. Schwarzschild--Burgers fluid flows
summary: We introduce a Physics-Informed Token Transformer (PITT) methodology for nonlinear hyperbolic balance laws in one space dimension, using piecewise steady-state profiles for the representation of approximate weak solutions. The method combines symbolic equation tokenization, a Fourier neural operator encoder, an explicit Rankine--Hugoniot law for shock motion, and a learned correction term. For clarity, we present it here for the relativistic Schwarzschild--Burgers equation, a scalar model for spherically symmetric fluid flows on a Schwarzschild background.
